text: {"lessons":["Before trimming a winner like Stock D, compare its outlook and portfolio weight with a pre-set target; the pleasure of locking in gains alone is not a sound sell signal.","When a holding is deeply below cost, judge it by its prospects and the role it serves now—not by the price I paid or the pain of realizing a loss.","Make buys and sells part of a consistent portfolio plan, and review whether each trade improves diversification and risk rather than reacting to short-term account swings."]}
